summary.en: Colombian forces continued intensive operations, with a strike in Cauca eliminating ten ELN fighters and a separate operation killing ten more ELN rebels, while President De la Espriella confirmed the death of two ELN leaders. A drone strike in Guapi wounded four soldiers and killed one Marine, and a car bomb at Casanare toll booths injured four women. A powerful earthquake killed over 250 people, a mine collapse in Nariño killed 14 miners, and Santa Marta declared a red alert for flash floods. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Colombianske styrker fortsatte intensive operasjoner, med et angrep i Cauca som eliminerte ti ELN-kjempere og en separat operasjon som drepte ti ELN-rebeller, mens president De la Espriella bekreftet døden til to ELN-ledere. Et droneangrep i Guapi såret fire soldater og drepte en marine, og en bilbombe ved bomstasjoner i Casanare såret fire kvinner. Et kraftig jordskjelv drepte over 250 personer, et gruvekollaps i Nariño drepte 14 gruvearbeidere, og Santa Marta erklærte rød alarm for flom. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
